title: Zicci: A Tale — Complete
author: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron
description: "Zicci: A Tale — Complete" by Baron Edward Bulwer Lytton Lytton is a novel written in the early 19th century.
longDescription: Set against the backdrop of Naples, the story revolves around a young English artist named Clarence Glyndon and his encounters with a mysterious figure named Zicci, as well as his romantic entanglement with the beautiful actress Isabel di Pisani.

authorInfo.bio: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron (1803–1873) is the author of Rienzi, the Last of the Roman Tribunes. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
